question: 1월과 2월 매출을 합치면 얼마야?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(o.items_ex_vat) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE r.refund_type WHEN 'FULL' THEN o.items_ex_vat ELSE r.refund_amount * 100 / 110 END), 0) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (order_id) WHERE o.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.paid_at) IN ('2026-01','2026-02')

question: 2월에 판매한 것 중 환불로 나간 비중은?
targets_conflict: 환불 비중 별칭, 전액·부분 환불, 결제 후 취소
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(CASE r.refund_type WHEN 'FULL' THEN o.items_ex_vat ELSE r.refund_amount * 100 / 110 END), 0) / SUM(o.items_ex_vat), 2) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (order_id) WHERE o.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.paid_at) IN ('2026-02')

question: 2월에 주문 취소가 몇 퍼센트나 돼?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(o.status='CANCELLED') / COUNT(*), 2) FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('PAID','CANCELLED') AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.ordered_at) IN ('2026-02')

question: 2~3월에 주문 하나당 평균 얼마 팔렸어?
targets_conflict: 객단가 별칭 변형, 새 기간 조합
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(1.0 * (SELECT SUM(o.items_ex_vat) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE r.refund_type WHEN 'FULL' THEN o.items_ex_vat ELSE r.refund_amount * 100 / 110 END), 0) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (order_id) WHERE o.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.paid_at) IN ('2026-02','2026-03')) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.status='PAID' AND o.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.paid_at) IN ('2026-02','2026-03')))
